title: GitHub Copilot sessions: obtaining tips for better usage.
summary: GitHub Copilot's Chronicle feature saves and indexes your coding sessions in a local SQLite database, letting you search past work with natural language queries and receive tips to optimize usage and reduce costs.
key_points: Chronicle tracks session metadata, conversation turns, files touched, and external references in a searchable local database
Secrets like tokens and API keys are automatically filtered before cloud sync
Commands like /chronicle:tips and /chronicle:cost-tips analyze your recent sessions to suggest improvements
VS Code stores chat sessions per-workspace in workspace storage, while Copilot CLI stores sessions globally in ~/.copilot/session-state/
You can export, import, or manually copy session files when migrating between machines

quotes.text: Secrets such as tokens, API keys, passwords, and connection strings are automatically filtered before data is synced to the cloud.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important security feature showing how sensitive data is protected during session synchronization

quotes.text: Chronicle will start analyzing your session store and it will give tips on how to optimize token usage in your coding sessions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates practical cost-saving capability that helps developers reduce GitHub Copilot expenses
